description: Dash proof for Terra Dust Devil followed by Aero Jet Burst (the Zephyr-pattern dash), with before/after observability snapshots and cleanup.
notes: Dust Devil and Jet Burst are issued as commands rather than abilities entries because the current ability-test action resolves every abilities entry from one selected style; this scenario must switch from Terra Sand to Aero Jet between casts.
The command vocabulary is current: dev class set, style, freecast, test ability, test mobs, observe marker, and observe snapshot are implemented command paths.

buildObservabilitySnapshot carries runtimePlayer.position. The before/after snapshots capture it, but the current runner expectedEvidence surface only asserts server-truth:snapshot presence; position-delta verification remains live/human comparison for now.
No expected projectile, client-intent, packet, or screenshot evidence is claimed for dash movement; ability_cast_end only proves the server cast lifecycle.
